summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed silently and orders were marked processed without payment.
recommended: Fix Decimal serialization in the payments client before redeploying v1.6
Add a CI test for payment payload serialization
Alert on payment provider call failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG

queue_max: 1000

Bad deploy v1.6 matches the timing. Roll back.
Rolled back version v1.6 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed silently and orders were marked processed without payment.

args.impact: Orders processed without payment while v1.6 was live (13 of 26 at alert time; the count kept growing). Reprocessing paid 35 orders, with money_recovered SAR 6159.65 and USD 3737.1, total_sar 20173.77. No ledger integrity failures.
recommended_actions: Fix Decimal serialization in the payments client before redeploying v1.6

args.summary: v1.6 broke payment calls because Decimal amounts could not be serialized. Orders were marked processed with no payment, and /health stayed green. I rolled back to v1.3 and reprocessed all unpaid orders, and the invariants are now green.
